# Copilot Code Review
WikiPiye is a wikipedia clone app almost 1:1 copy of it made in Flutter and Django Ninja.
In code review always use Indoonesian when offering suggestions or reviews. When reviewing Flutter PR changes refer to this [GUIDELINES for Flutter Project](https://github.com/Codecooo/WikiPiye/blob/main/app/GUIDELINES.md)
while when reviewing Django Ninja PR changes refer to this [GUIDELINES for Django](https://github.com/Codecooo/WikiPiye/blob/main/wikipiye_api/GUIDELINES.md)
